Zara (Partnerships): Quick sync: proposing an "ecosystem bridge" playbook to streamline SI onboarding when a hardware partner + marketplace listing + joint announcement are involved. Goal: one repeatable path so SIs can go from onboarding -> certified -> co-marketed in ~4 weeks. Thoughts?
Anik (SI Enablement): Love it. Recommended pillars: intake & legal, sandbox + infra plumbing, hands-on lab (marketplace + private deploy + hw smoke), certification rubric, co-marketing checklist. Keep the first pilot small: 1 SI + 1 HW vendor.
Luc (Marketplace): Agree. We need a manifest template + a sandbox tenant per SI. I can pre-provision tenants and a sample SKU. Will add a lightweight validation script for manifests.
Evelyn (DevEx): I'll build a starter repo that includes infra templates, a preflight script, and the evidence-bundle uploader. Also will produce an "observability troubleshooting" card for the lab.
Sam (HW Partnerships): From HW side: acceptance tests must include connectivity, model artifact checksum, and perf smoke. We should ship an acceptance checklist to the SI and require signed hardware terms before we run the lab. Customs/shipping window ~2 weeks.
Zara (Partnerships): Good notes. Co-marketing: draft joint announcement timeline needs legal and comms pre-clear. We should pair the announcement date to the SI pass date + 1 week for final approvals.
Anik (SI Enablement): For certification, propose criteria: pass 3/3 stations (marketplace listing + private deploy + hw acceptance) OR 2/3 + remediation sign-off. Evidence required: logs, screenshots, manifest. We'll integrate with LMS to auto-issue a "Bridge Certified" badge.
Luc (Marketplace): Manifest validator snippet I'll provide. Example manifest in sandbox (no PII):
```yaml
name: example-skill
version: 0.1
entrypoint: /app/run
resources:
  memory: 1024MB
  model: open-quant-v2
```
Evelyn (DevEx): Preflight command for partners:
```bash
# create sandbox project and run checks
redwoodctl sandbox create --org=si-bridge-pilot --name=team-alpha
./preflight.sh --project team-alpha --api-key $PARTNER_KEY
```
Sam (HW Partnerships): Shipping note: we will require signed waiver and serial registration. Also will include a quickstart image and return label.
NotifyBot: calendar invite created for 2026-08-18 15:00 UTC (rehearsal 2026-08-16 16:00 UTC). Recording disabled by default.
Zara (Partnerships): Action items: Luc -> manifest validator + tenant provisioning (due 2026-07-30); Evelyn -> starter repo + preflight + uploader endpoint (due 2026-07-28); Anik -> rubric + LMS integration + proctor plan (due 2026-07-29); Sam -> hardware terms + acceptance checklist + ship ETA (due 2026-07-25); Zara -> comms draft + joint announcement outline + outreach to SI (due 2026-07-27).
Anik (SI Enablement): Evidence bundle format for LMS: participant_email, station_id, result, artifacts_url. Uploader returns signed URLs we can ingest.
Luc (Marketplace): I'll also prepare a lightweight "listing checklist" card partners keep after the lab (required fields, common errors).
Evelyn (DevEx): I'll add an optional lab exercise showing routing fallbacks (cost vs latency) and a short troubleshooting runbook.
Sam (HW Partnerships): I'll coordinate with partner ops for shipping and confirm spare kit availability.
Zara (Partnerships): If everyone is aligned, I'll open outreach to 3 SIs and 2 HW vendors for the pilot. We'll keep cohort small to iterate on the playbook. Anyone object?
Luc (Marketplace): No objections.
Evelyn (DevEx): All good. I'll start the starter repo today.
Anik (SI Enablement): Ready to proctor.
Sam (HW Partnerships): OK from HW side pending waiver sign.
Zara (Partnerships): Great. We'll reconvene after the rehearsal. Thanks team! :rocket:
